o.text: Internationalism; ultimately from Latin planēta and Ancient Greek πλανήτης (planḗtēs, “wanderer, planet”).

Morphologically, from yeri- + -iş. Doublet of yürüş.
Cognates
* Bashkir йөрөш (yürüş, “walk”)
* Crimean Tatar yürüş (“walk; hike, march”),
* Gagauz örüyüş (“walk”),
* Karakalpak júris (“walk”),
* Kazakh жүріс (jüris, “motion, movement”),
* Krymchak йуруш (“gait”),
* Kyrgyz жүрүш (jürüş, “walk”),
* Kumyk юрюш (yurüş, “walk, gait, behaviour”),
* Nogai юрис (yuris, “walk”),
* Southern Altai јӱрӱш (ǰürüš, “walk”),
* Tatar йөреш (yöreş, “walk”),
* Turkish yeriş (“walk; fight, scuffle”) (Arpaçay, Kars; Erzurum), Turkish yürüyüş,
* Turkmen ýöriş (“walk”),
* Uyghur يۈرىش (yürish, “gate”),
* Uzbek yurish (“gate”)
